name: Pepperoni "Charcuterie" Bento Box with Mozzarella, Crackers, Mandarin, Almonds, Apricots & Celery

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Place almonds and apricots in the small compartments of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup almonds, honey roasted
⅓ cup dried apricot

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry celery. Fill the inside groove of the celery with cheese spread, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in the medium compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 stick celery
3 tbsp cheddar cheese spread

instructions.primary_message: Cut cheese into thin slices. Place cheese, pepperoni, crackers, and mandarin in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
57 g mozzarella cheese
43 g pepperoni
1 mini sleeve ritz crackers
1 mandarin

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
